name: Exterior Soffit RP Protection & Setup
intent: Ground protection below soffit drip zone (critical for overhead scraping debris), fixture masking, fascia junction masking (LF — mandatory in RP), vent masking, equipment setup by method.
doctrine: RP soffit protection. Fascia masking at 120 LF/hr is MANDATORY in RP (fascia almost always already finished). Vent masking prevents further paint clogging during brush application. Ground protection catches scraping debris in addition to drips. Equipment setup at global rates: brush 5 min, spray 12 min.
